mapper.sql: ce.id AS id, ce.title AS title, ce.description AS description, ce.start_at AS start_at, ce.end_at AS end_at, ce.author_username AS author_username, ce.color AS color, ce.completed AS completed, ce.shared AS shared, ce.created_at AS created_at, u.profile_image AS author_profile_image, u.nickname AS author_nickname
mapper.select: SELECT FROM moondap.md_calendar_event ce LEFT JOIN moondap.md_user u ON ce.author_username = u.username ORDER BY ce.start_at
SELECT FROM moondap.md_calendar_event ce LEFT JOIN moondap.md_user u ON ce.author_username = u.username WHERE ce.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moondap.md_calendar_event (title, description, start_at, end_at, author_username, color, shared, completed) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{authorUsername}, #{color}, #{shared}, #{completed})
mapper.update: UPDATE moondap.md_calendar_event SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, color = #{color}, shared = #{shared}, completed = #{completed} WHERE id = #{id}
